description: EstateBoost: prepare (unsigned) a refresh of a crew's Estate boost. Open to anyone; it pays nothing and costs only gas. Pass homeIds (the crew owner's apartment ids, strictly ascending) so apartments count. Refused with the reason if the contract is paused and no boost is live, the crew does not exist, or the same boost was written too recently.

homeIds.description: Apartment ids the crew's owner holds, strictly ascending. May be empty.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_estate_boost_refresh
